analysis_1_delta_specialized_vs_baseline.description: Compare mean score on quality_baseline profile (general+summarization) vs domain-specific profiles per use case. by_difficulty_tests: prompt-level unpaired bootstrap per tier, Holm p and Bonferroni CI across tiers (tiers with fewer than 2 prompts in a group are skipped).

analysis_2_model_size_correlation.description: Mean composite score per generator model vs parameter count (size_B = nominal size from the model name; size_B_reported = total parameters per `ollama show`)

analysis_3_interjudge_disagreement_by_pr.description: Std dev of composite scores across 4 judges per prompt (per generator, then averaged)

analysis_4_intrajudge_variance_by_domain.description: Mean and std dev of scores per judge model × use case (across all generators × prompts)

analysis_5_judge_generator_bias_matrix.description: Mean composite score for each (judge_model, generator_model) pair; diagonal = self-evaluation. self_preference_rate.spr is the legacy model-level measure used in arXiv v1 — see analysis_7.

analysis_6_self_eval_vs_cross_eval.description: Comparison of self-evaluation (judge==generator) vs cross-evaluation scores per model

analysis_7_self_preference_formal.description: Self-preference relative to reference judges from other families. spr_self: share of prompts where the judge ranks its own output first (ties split) vs how often reference judges do; spr_family: same for the judge's family; score_bias_*: difference-in-differences on composite scores (controls output quality and judge severity). Percentile bootstrap over prompts, two-sided p; per measure, Holm-adjusted p and Bonferroni-adjusted CI across judges (ci95 = unadjusted, reference only).

lfm2.5-1.2b-thinking.caveat: production-mode judge scores recovered by the flattened-JSON fallback: one shared flag/reason copied to all criteria
